paketerstellen.mach-aus-deinen-eigenen: Make a package from your own folder types and views that you install in another Ablago installation with “Upload package”. Users and passwords never come along, folders and documents only as examples you choose explicitly.
paketerstellen.name: Name
paketerstellen.kleinbuchstaben-ziffern-u: Lower-case letters, digits and _, e.g. {code}. Stays the same for every version.
paketerstellen.ein-zwei-saetze-was: One or two sentences: what the package brings and for whom ({min}–{max} characters). The README is also made from it.
paketerstellen.z-b-feld-kundennummer: e.g. field customer number on the contract
paketerstellen.steht-im-changelog-leer: Goes into the CHANGELOG; empty: “First version.” or “New version …”.
paketerstellen.wenn-dort-die-abhaengigke: , if the dependencies are installed there
paketerstellen.das-paket-hat-dieselbe: The package has passed the same check as when uploading – like this it can be installed in another Ablago installation{wert}.
paketerstellen.mappentypen-ansichten-und: Search folder types, views and word lists
paketerstellen.kommt-beim-export-als: Comes along on export as a dependency, not as a copy
paketerstellen.nach-der-installation-des: Changed after the package was installed – Ablago only knows the details after the package’s next update
paketerstellen.gleichbedeutende-woerter-: Synonyms for the search (Workbench → Search). For the recipient they appear under “from packages”; groups from installed packages don’t come along.
paketerstellen.rundgaenge.text: Own tours from Workbench → Tours. Folder types they open must go into the package or come from an installed package.
paketerstellen.ohne-auswahl-enthaelt-das: Without a selection the package contains no folders. If you choose folders, their field values go into the package as examples – only use folders with invented data, e.g. load test folders. Passwords, notes and links to folders not chosen stay out, and so do documents – unless you explicitly include them below.
paketerstellen.waehle-zuerst-eigene-mapp: Choose folder types of your own first.
paketerstellen.mit-dokumenten: Include their documents (PDF, PNG, JPEG) – only documents with invented data, no real invoices, contracts or letters
paketerstellen.tipps.text: Own tips from Workbench → Tips. If a tip starts an own tour, include the tour. Adaptations of tips from other packages are not included.
paketerstellen.automatisierungen.text: Your own automations from Workbench → Automations. Their folder types must come along or come from a package. Fixed people and roles become the creator of the folder; Workbench cards, outward cards and “Call from outside” do not come along. They are off on installation.
